title: feat(record-page): on a phone the record's comments open as a page: threads first, replies inside, the box docked at the foot, a long press for actions (#36076)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLteuRKBSRXDK9REnG68QAD)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTfxZyB5T41DdoPaBy

Fixes #36076

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@object-ui/plugin-detail` exports `CommentsPage` and `CommentsPageProps`; `CommentThread` takes a third `mode` (`'page'`) and optional `itemInteraction`, `heldId` and `onHeldActions`; `CommentItem` an optional `interactionProps`; `CommentComposer` and `RichTextCommentInput` an optional `layout` (`'default' | 'phone'`). `@object-ui/app-shell` reserves the console URL parameter `comments` (`RECORD_COMMENTS_PARAM`, listed in `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS`). `@object-ui/i18n` gains four `detail.*` keys in every pack. Nothing is removed or re-typed; the desktop is unchanged.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 手机上打开一条记录，右上角多了评论图标，旁边是未解决的评论串数。点了进**整页**评论，盖在记录页上；左上「‹ 记录名」或系统返回键回到记录页，记录页滚到哪还在哪（实测返回前后都是 74）。
- **两层**：列表只列第一层评论，有回复的下面是回复人头像加「N 条回复」；点一条进这一串，原评论在上，回复按时间往下，左上「‹ 评论」回列表。
- **输入框固定在屏幕底部**，键盘弹起时站在键盘上面。平时一行，点了展开，下面一排：提到人、加粗、斜体、列表、代码，右边发送。在列表里发的是新评论，在一串里发的是回复（两个框各留各的草稿）。页面上没有「Ctrl+Enter」字样。
- **长按一条评论**（或系统的长按菜单），从底部升起面板：第一行六个表情，下面「标记已解决」（只在第一层）、「编辑」「删除」（红色，点了先确认）。每一项出现的条件和电脑端悬停那排完全一样，手机没有另判权限。
- 列表右上角筛选：「显示已解决」「只看我参与的」，和电脑端同一个菜单。手机上「动态」页签只剩系统记录。
- **删除的门**：#36186+#36191 已合并并合入本分支。手机长按面板和电脑端用同一套判定：普通成员能删自己没有回复的评论，能给自己看得到的任何评论串标记已解决。
- 不改电脑端，不改任何权限和服务端。

## What changes

**The phone's comment page** (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `src/comments/`)

- `CommentsPage`: a full-screen page (`role="dialog"`, fixed over the host) that reads `useRecordComments()`, the same discussion, writes and gates as the desktop panel. Props: `threadId` (`null` = the list), `onOpenThread`, `onBack`, `backLabel`, `onEngage`.
  - The list draws each thread with `CommentThread mode="summary"`; a tap on a comment outside its own controls, Enter on a focused comment, or its 「N 条回复」 opens the thread. A thread that is not held (deleted, stale link) shows the list.
  - The thread draws `CommentThread mode="page"` (new): its comment, then every reply, with no reply box of its own; 「回复」 there puts the caret in the docked box.
  - Two docked `CommentComposer layout="phone"` boxes (list and reply), each keeping its own draft; the list's stays mounted while a thread is open, so its draft and the list's scroll survive a visit to a thread.
  - The page follows the on-screen keyboard through `visualViewport` (top and height while the keyboard covers more than 80 px), the same reading as `PhoneListPanels`' sheet; the inline style is positional only.
  - Esc returns one level (`data-owns-escape`); the focus lands on 「‹」 when a level opens.
- `useCommentPress`: 500 ms hold, cancelled past 10 px of travel; the click that ends a hold is swallowed. `onPressStart` fires at the press itself (pointer down, context menu, Enter/Space), and the page hands it `onEngage`, so the host's question about the comment's actions is on the wire before the hold completes. `contextmenu` opens the same sheet (Android's own long press, the keyboard's menu key, a right click). One record of the press serves every comment.
- `CommentActionSheet` (vaul `Drawer`): six reactions (the viewer's own marked `aria-pressed`), then Mark resolved / Reopen, Edit, Delete (destructive). A row is drawn only where the comment's `CommentItemActions` hands its handler: these are the object `CommentThread.actionsOf` builds for the desktop's hover row, so every gate is the thread's. The sheet is never a snapshot of the press: `CommentThread` takes `heldId` and reports the held comment's current actions to `onHeldActions` each time what they offer changes, so a verdict that lands while the sheet is up adds its rows (L1-c REWORK 7070700220). A comment with no action raises nothing.
- `CommentsFilterMenu`: the desktop panel's filter menu, extracted unchanged so both surfaces draw the same one.
- `CommentItem.interactionProps`: spread on the comment's box with `select-none` and no iOS callout, except while it is being edited.
- `RichTextCommentInput layout="phone"`: the editor first, then one row (mention, bold, italic, list, code; send at the right end, round, 44 px), no preview, the names without their shortcut (`detail.formatBold`, `detail.formatItalic`), 16 px text. A press on the row keeps the caret (and the keyboard) in the box. The default layout is untouched.

**The record page** (`@object-ui/app-shell`)

- `commentsPageOffered` in `RecordDetailView`: the same rule as `commentsPanelOffered` (feeds on, a standard page, a record id) on a phone and not embedded. `commentsSurfaceOffered` (either one) now drives what `commentsPanelOffered` drove: the discussion rides the open's payload, the 动态 stream gives the comments up (`RecordCommentsInPanelContext`) and its count leaves them out.
- `?comments=` (list) / `?comments=<id>` (thread), read from the router: opening and a thread push an entry flagged `__commentsPushed` in history state (the entry's other state kept); 「‹」 pops a flagged entry and otherwise replaces the URL one level up (a reload or a shared link). The page is mounted inside the record's `DiscussionContextProvider`, over the record, which stays mounted, so nothing is read again and the scroll is kept. Closing returns the focus to the top bar's comments icon.
- The phone's `RecordTopBar` gets the `comments` slot (`CommentsButton` at 44 px).
- The explain probes: `moderatesComments` is asked while the panel or the page is open; `updatesOthersComments` on the first press on a comment (the page's `onEngage`, fired at pointer down), as on the desktop's first reach into the panel. Opening the record asks nothing more.

**Strings**: `detail.addReactionEmoji`, `detail.commentThread`, `detail.formatBold`, `detail.formatItalic` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated) and the provider-less defaults; the rest reuse existing keys (`detail.sendComment` already existed).

**Docs**: `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` (### On a phone) and the plugin-detail README (### The phone's comment page).

**Pending release notes**: `.changeset/36075-record-comments-panel.md` (from #36114) is left as it stands on main. Its line "the phone keeps the comments in its 动态 tab" is answered in this PR's own changeset, which says that on a phone the comments live on the phone's page and that this replaces that line. `36075-comments-resolved.md` ("…and the phone keep their feed as before") is left as it stands too; the same sentence of this PR's changeset answers it.

## Small calls made here (dev-thread rule, Sales 22:19:27Z)

1. The full page is a URL parameter over the record route, not a new route: the record stays mounted (no re-read, scroll kept), precedent `?related=`.
2. No 「回复」 row in the long-press sheet: in a thread the docked box is the reply; in the list a tap opens the thread.
3. No 「预览」 on the phone toolbar; the card's row lists mention, bold, italic, list, code and send.
4. The filter is the desktop's dropdown, not a bottom sheet.
5. A long press on a comment with no available action opens nothing (a read-only discussion).
6. Thread title 「评论串」; the list keeps 「评论」.

## Overlap

- #36136 (wide-screen pinned details): conflicts textually in `RecordDetailView.tsx`; the regions differ (layout vs the comment wiring); whichever lands second merges main.
- #36200 (#36186+#36191 comment doors): MERGED (d12ac84e) and merged into this branch with no conflict. The phone sheet draws from the same `actionsOf`, so it takes the new ✓ gate (any thread the viewer reads) and the own-comment delete door (`ownCommentDeletesOnly`: own comment with no reply only) with no code change; one CommentsPage test expectation moved from `['delete']` to `['resolve','delete']`, and a new test pins the door on the phone sheet.
- #36151 (phone record bottom bar, not pushed yet) and #36147: same file, different blocks.

## Verification

**New tests (all pass)**

- `plugin-detail/src/comments/CommentsPage.test.tsx` (18): the list shows top-level comments with 「2 replies」, no reply; a tap on a comment or its count opens the thread, a tap on a reaction is the reaction's; Enter opens; 「‹」 names the record; the docked box writes a comment, toolbar order @ B I list code Send, no 「Ctrl」 in the page; a thread shows comment then replies and replies to its comment; a missing thread shows the list; the list draft survives a thread visit; long press on own comment: 6 reactions (own one pressed), resolve, edit, delete, and the release opens nothing, `onEngage` once; another's comment: no edit or delete; a reply: no resolve; a sheet reaction toggles, Delete reaches the host; a press that travels is a scroll; contextmenu opens the sheet; read-only raises nothing and docks no box; a moderator's press on another's comment engages at pointer down, the sheet opens with Mark resolved and Delete, and when `updatesOthersComments` turns true with the sheet up Edit joins (fails on the pre-fix head); behind the own-comment delete door Delete is on the viewer's own reply only, not on their comment with replies nor on another's reply; resolved threads hidden by default with the filter offered.
- `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.commentsPanel-36075.test.tsx`, new top-level describe (6), the real `RecordDetailView` at 375: the top-bar icon with 「2」, a press pushes `?comments=` (flagged) and draws the list over the still-mounted record; tap → `?comments=c-ada` with the reply, 「‹」 → list → record, focus on the icon; a link straight to a thread: 「‹」 replaces one level up twice; the 动态 tab draws no comment and no 「Ctrl」; no icon with feeds off; a moderator's first long press on Grace's comment with the `sys_comment` explain answered late: no comment explain before the press, asked at the press, the sheet shows Delete, then Edit and Delete once the answer lands (fails on the pre-fix head).

**Local runs** (after merging main `cbd582f4`): every `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.*`, `plugin-detail/src/comments` and `i18n` test file, 209 files, 2,830 tests pass. Before the merge, a wider set (all `RecordDetailView.*`, `recordCommentsPanel*`, `ObjectView.phone*`, `app-shell/src/__tests__`, all of `plugin-detail` and `i18n`): 640 files, 6,991 tests pass. `tsc` (src and tests) clean for plugin-detail and app-shell. ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors (warnings only of the kinds already in these files). `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against main; #36136 conflict as above. After the L1-c fix: all of `plugin-detail` (405 files, 3,745 tests) and the host comments file (16 tests) pass; ESLint 0 errors on the touched files.

**Browser evidence** (CRM example on `objectstack dev --fresh`, console on Vite from this branch, zh-CN, 375×812 touch, light and dark; seat-side folder `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36076/`, script and readings in its README)

| Shot | Reading |
|---|---|
| Record page | icon 「3」 at the top bar's right |
| List | 「‹ Globex Ltd」 · 评论 · filter; three first-level comments, 「2 条回复」 under the first |
| Thread | comment, then both replies; URL `?comments=<id>` |
| Composer expanded | @ B I list code, round send at the right; the box's bottom at 812 (the viewport's) |
| Long press, own comment | six reactions, 标记已解决, 编辑, 删除 (red) |
| After 👍 | 「👍 1」 under the comment, marked as own |
| Back to the record | scrollTop 74 before, 74 after |
| 动态 tab | 「动态 (0)」, no comment, no box |

Not shown in the browser (the run's only account is an administrator, who moderates): a member's long press on someone else's comment; pinned by the unit test above. The iOS keyboard cannot be emulated in headless Chromium.
